title: Sharh al-Siyar al-Kabir
altTitles: Commentary on al-Shaybani's Great Book of the Law of Nations
author: as-sarakhsi
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Al-Sarakhsi's commentary on al-Shaybani's Siyar al-Kabir, the founding text of Islamic law on war, peace and relations with other polities. It treats the conduct of campaigns, safe-conduct, treaties, captives, spoils and the status of foreigners, and preserves al-Shaybani's text within the commentary.
historicalContext: Al-Shaybani's Siyar is often called the first treatise on the law of nations, and it survives complete chiefly through this commentary. Al-Sarakhsi dictated it at the end of his life, after his release from prison.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
